# mxroute_domain_pointer (Data Source)

Look up one pointer using a complete successful list; ambiguous matches are errors. Mock-tested alpha; runtime API behavior remains live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_domain_pointer" "example" {
  domain  = "example.com"
  pointer = "alias.example.net"
}
```

### Required

- `domain` (String) Canonical owned domain name.
